+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SCRIPTS = ROOT / "scripts"
+if str(SCRIPTS) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPTS))
+
+import training_data_admission_v1 as target
+
+import json
+import gzip
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from collections import Counter
+import training_data_admission_v1 as admission
+
+def test_normalize_license_underscore_hyphen_equivalence():
+    assert admission.normalize_license('project_generated') == 'project-generated'
+    assert admission.normalize_license('private_generated') == 'private-generated'
+    assert admission.normalize_license('PROJECT_GENERATED') == 'project-generated'
+    assert admission.normalize_license('Private_Generated') == 'private-generated'
+    assert admission.normalize_license('Apache-2.0') == 'apache-2.0'
+    assert admission.normalize_license('MIT') == 'mit'
+
+
+def test_normalize_license_double_hyphen_collapse():
+    assert admission.normalize_license('some--license') == 'some-license'
+    assert admission.normalize_license('some---license') == 'some-license'
+
+
+def test_license_decision_with_generated_licenses():
+    counts = Counter({'project-generated': 1, 'private-generated': 2})
+    result = admission.license_decision(counts, private_train_path=False, dogfood_path=False)
+    assert result.startswith('allowed_')
